name: – Niclas Herbst – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the Commission spent the 2023 EU budget, plus the budgets of six executive agencies and the European Development Funds for aid to African, Caribbean and Pacific countries. It also closes the accounts for that year. Alongside this approval, it lists many concerns: a rising error rate in EU spending (5.6% overall, 9.3% in cohesion policy), record unpaid commitments of 543 billion euro, growing EU debt, and weak controls in some member states. It asks the Commission to fix these problems.

- Parliament signs off the 2023 budget but flags errors and weak controls.
- Affects the Commission, six agencies, and aid spending in partner countries.
- Next: the Commission must report back on fixing the problems.
